independentReview: No blocking findings; 500 additional score configurations and extreme/different-duration renders checked; both source pins independently verified against GitHub bytes.

limitations: Original EventScore timing/pitch/gates/pan are preserved for routed notes; only velocity is scaled by the layer gain.
Sound is a new arrangement: marimba replaces pluck/bell, sine substitutes pad/texture/bass. Original live DSP effects/weather are not reproduced.
Out-of-range marimba pitches use explicitly counted sine fallback without octave folding.
Tom/cymbal layers must be muted while drums are enabled; bank does not contain those instruments.
Percussion one-shots retain natural sample tails; stopping at duration minus 2 seconds explicitly releases all voices.
Offline Node qualification only; no PWA, Android, VST integration, listening approval or release claim.
